Description: data/ (probes, snapshots, InjecAgent and panel corpora, datasheet), results/ (raw per-phase logs, hand-read labels, captured configuration), src/ (harness, analysis, verifier); all attack goals are harmless canary strings; all runs used local models.
harness: AutoGen autogen-agentchat / autogen-core / autogen-ext 0.7.5 (requirements.txt; paper env listing paper/tables/env_listing.json: Python 3.11.16, AutoGen 0.7.5, openai 3.19.2, transformers 5.17.0, torch 2.14.0). Tag python-v0.7.5 was released 2025-09-30 and is the latest python release listed (https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/releases/tag/python-v0.7.5); verified code commit 83afbf5857aac683340d4c692194e548b1e8edda in the profile (D-303). The team: RoundRobin researcher + writer (+ model-less ingest agent for agent entry), MaxMessageTermination(len(members)+1), TextMentionTermination('TERMINATE') in phase 10 (sources=['writer'] in the writer-only condition), ListMemory for memory entry, SelectorGroupChat in phase 13, no streaming (create_stream raises) (src/harness.py at 1da92ac7). Open AutoGen issues filed against current versions that touch features used here: #8282 TextMentionTermination(sources=...) drops sources on dump_component/load_component (https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/issues/8282; relevant only if the team was serialised, which the harness does not appear to do); #8293 ListMemory MemoryContent.mime_type degenerates to str after dump/load (https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/issues/8293; may shape MemoryQueryEvent raw dumps); #8277 finish_reason 'unknown' in create_stream (https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/issues/8277; not applicable, no streaming). Model server: LM Studio at 127.0.0.1:1234 (version not recorded). Analysis harness: src/analyze.py and src/verify_numbers.py (the paper's numbers).
models: qwen/qwen3.5-9b: both team agents (researcher, writer), the phase-13 selector and the LLM guard (block guard in phases 3-6, 12, 13); served locally by LM Studio, temperature 0, seed 20260924, reasoning_effort 'none' via extra_body; phase-0 capture echoes the same id (paper/tables/env_listing.json). Weights, quantisation and LM Studio version not recorded (phase-10n census §2.4)

expected_counts: Zip 4,978,620 B (profile pin; Zenodo API). Members 109, all selected by ingest (census §1); = GitHub HEAD 138 blobs minus 29 paper/ blobs. Candidate run files 14 results/**/runs.jsonl (profile include globs), 1,270 rows: 1,080 run rows in 11 files (phase2 340, phase3 120, phase4 60, phase5 30, phase6/{none,model,bus,tool} 20 each, phase10 210, phase12 160, phase13 80) and 190 non-run rows in 3 files (phase7 150 rail rows, phase8 20 LangGraph, phase9 20 CrewAI) (census §2.1; artefacts.toml autogen.art.non_run_rows 190; profile runs = {rows 1270, runs 1080, rail 150, framework 40}). Units = executions 1,080 (registry tools/readme_corpora.toml count 1080 runs basis census; trial §8/§9: 1,080 mapped, 0 degenerate, 1,040 agent_execution + 40 outcome_only); register rows 190 (§9). Paper: team runs 860 on the test carriers (120+120+60+30+80+210+160+80; phase 2 TwoRuns=120, not 340), plus 150/20/20 for phases 7/8/9.
expected_arms: Facets: phase x arm-dir (phase 6 none/model/bus/tool) x entry {tool,user,agent,memory} x modes (placement blocking) x block_guard x defense (phase 12) x condition (phases 10, 13) x probe group/carrier. One model (qwen/qwen3.5-9b) for all. Per phase: P2 observe, 85 probes x 4 entries = 340 (30 test-carrier probes = 120 in the paper, 220 off-test rows not in the paper's team tables); P3 model block 30 x 4 = 120; P4 bus block 30 x {user,agent} = 60; P5 tool block 30 x {tool} = 30; P6 InjecAgent 20 cases x {none,model,bus,tool}, tool entry = 80; P10 keyword: observe 40, control 40, model block 40, bus block 40, tool block 10 (tool entry only), writer-only 40 = 210; P12 spotlight 80 + sandwich 80 (20 probes x 4 entries each); P13 selector 80 (20 probes x 4 entries). Entry totals tool 345 / user 255 / agent 255 / memory 225 and modes observe-all 560 / model block 180 / bus block 120 / tool block 60 (phase 12 rows have no modes) reproduce the census exactly under this design. Expected missing by design: bus block for tool and memory entries in phase 4 (phase 10 bus-blocks all four entries, phase 6 the tool entry; corrected by fact-check), tool block for non-tool entries, phases 2-5 on 40 of 50 carriers (except the phase-2 extra rows).

discrepancy_leads: L-01 Extra phase-2 runs: the deposit holds 340 phase-2 rows, the paper reports 120 (TwoRuns; analyze.py keeps only probes whose carrier is in config test_carriers c00-c04, c25-c29; Limitations say phases 2 to 6 and 8 to 10 use the 10 test carriers [corrected wording by fact-check]). The other 220 rows (55 probes x 4 entries by the census arithmetic) are published but not in the team tables; only the memory-wrapper comparison (MemRawN = 29) uses them. Source: https://github.com/rezaduty/autogen-guard-placement/blob/1da92ac75869c18ec24635902e4db1a1ad826279/src/analyze.py

L-02 Harness version drift: src/harness.py at HEAD always writes a stop_reason key, but the census found it absent in 240 phase-2 rows, so at least those rows came from an earlier harness than the one published. Source: https://github.com/rezaduty/autogen-guard-placement/blob/1da92ac75869c18ec24635902e4db1a1ad826279/src/harness.py (line ~593); census §2.2

L-03 Error count is 0 by construction: set_aside_errors moves errored rows to runs_errors.jsonl before resuming (docstring: 'the paper reports their count'), but no runs_errors.jsonl is in the repository (and none is listed in the census), and the paper's *Errors macros (all 0) are computed on the kept rows. The 3 aborted attempts in phase-2 events (2 of them on test carriers c03 and c04) show runs were re-attempted. Source: src/run_experiment.py set_aside_errors; artefacts.toml autogen.art.errored_runs_set_aside

L-04 Reasoning: config sets reasoning_effort 'none' and the phase-0 echo has 0 reasoning characters, yet the census counts 267 ThoughtEvents (writer 229, researcher 38). Either the server ignored the setting for some calls or the setting changed during the study. Source: config.json, paper/tables/env_listing.json; census §2.2

L-05 Run window vs capture: the phase-0 capture is 2026-09-24T13:12:38Z and the repository's first commit with all logs is 2026-09-25T14:28:00Z. Rows produced before the capture (e.g. the stop_reason-less phase-2 batch) would not be covered by the capture that grounds the agent-model identity (D-305 rule autogen.config_agent_model_unverified@1). Sources: census §2.4; https://github.com/rezaduty/autogen-guard-placement/commit/a6675f8f7b8d2f94c7d6b89b244a8e7d51e9237d

L-06 Deposit vs repository: the Zenodo zip (2026-09-28) postdates the repository HEAD (2026-09-25). 109 members = 138 HEAD blobs minus 29 paper/ blobs, so the deposit is probably HEAD without paper/. Any member whose git-blob id differs from HEAD (in particular the 14 runs.jsonl, 11 events.jsonl, 13 guard_raw.jsonl) would be an unannounced change between the two releases.

L-07 Our own docs are stale after D-321: the registry caveat (_AUTOGEN_CAVEAT) still says 'never imported ... the 190 non-run rows are registered by file', the profile header says the runner maps one item per artefact, and artefacts.toml autogen.art.non_run_rows says 'Registered by file'; the §9 trial registers 190 rows one by one (documentation-mismatch in our docs, S3). Sources: src/agentprov/adapters/registry/__init__.py l.162-167; profile header; phase10n README §9

L-08 Issue counts differ between our two reports: in-memory mapping §7.1 gives block_effect_in_request_log 139 and block_subject_not_recorded 69, the product-path trial §8 gives 87 and 49 (other codes equal). Probably occurrences vs executions; to confirm which unit the L2 import reports.

L-09 Phase-12 rows have no modes field and phases 10/12/13 no block_guard field (inferred: census modes total 560+180+120+60 = 920 = 1,080 - 160; block_guard llm 630 = phases 2-6). The guard placements of those phases come from the profile/paper, not from the row.
L-10 Attacker-tool counts: the census counts 28 attacker-tool calls, the paper 16 runs with at least one (6+2+5+3); consistent only if some runs call more than one attacker tool.

L-11 Paper's config listing (paper/tables/config_listing.json) is a subset of config.json at HEAD (no llm27, panel, test_carriers, gateway keys); the run-time config of the team phases cannot be told apart from the later-extended file. Low impact.
checks_not_applicable: L1-04 cross-corpus duplicates: no other corpus holds this deposit or AutoGen runs of this team (the scan still runs; expect 0)

L2 sampling: the L2 unit is the whole runs.jsonl member (autogen files are selected whole, tools/precheck/l2_import.py), so with 14 files (< 30) the 'sample' is the whole part: 1,080 executions + 190 register rows; outcome comparison is on the population, not a sample
L2 withholding: the profile has no [withhold] table; check only that nothing is withheld
L2 redaction: the profile has no [redact] table; check only that no account path appears (expect 0)

Utility outcome: the paper's benign-completion check (3 shared content words of 6+ letters, no withheld marker) is not produced by our pipeline; benign completion is reported for reference, not compared

First-hop compliance and guard catch/disrupt rates: paper metrics derived from events; our SEM claims cover canary presence, attacker-tool calls and keyword stops only, so these are optional cross-checks without a verdict
Phases 7, 8, 9 outcome numbers: not executions in our part (register rows only)
